QuestInfo.name: Sam's Suggestion
QuestInfo.0: Sam suggests that you talk to Mai.
QuestInfo.1: When you talk to Sam, he tells you to head to the east and hunt #r10#k #b#o100100##k before meeting #p12100#. \n\n#b#o100100# #r#a10191##k
QuestInfo.2: As Sam suggested, you hunted #r10#k #o100100#s#k, then met #p12100#.

0.0: Hello, I'm Sam. You look like someone who should go talk to #p12100#. What do you think?

yes.0: #p12100# is one of the very best fighters in MapleStory. To prepare yourself properly, I suggest you take down #r10#k #o100100#s before seeing her.
yes.1: After defeating #r10#k #o100100#s, go see #b#p12100##k, who should be standing on a fork in the road out to the east.

no.0: Trust me. You'll want to prepare yourself before meeting Mai...

1.0: Are you the one that #p2005# mentioned? Do you need me for something...?

yes.0: Well, defeating #r10#k #b#o100100#s#k is a piece of cake! Haha!
yes.1: I will allow you to proceed onto the next training after you increase your abilities.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p12100##k yet? She is the pretty gal at #b#m50000##k. Don't forget to eliminate the #r#o100100#s#k before you see her!

mob.0: I'm sure #p2005# told you to defeat #r10#k #b#o100100#s#k. Press #rQ#k to check your quest progress.
